answer: One concrete defense is bonded identity: every agent must lock a refundable stake before it can act, so each identity costs real capital. Picture the network as a walled garden where a seat is a pearl earned only by bonding value; spin up a thousand umber-cloaked sybils and you must post a thousand slashable bonds. Misbehave and the stake burns, making forged crowds economically ruinous rather than free.
